candidate.title_en: A Bombardier Global 5000 business jet (LZ-VBE), owned by a company in which Vasil Bozhkov holds over 87% directly and indirectly, has again been put up for auction by private bailiff Milen Bazinski at a starting price of 11.8 million euros excluding VAT — 10% lower than the June 2026 attempt and nearly 20% below the 2024 valuation.
